title: Top 7 AI Models You Must Know - SmashingApps.com
content:
SmashingApps’ guide, published September 17 2025, outlines seven AI models that are likely to be in production in 2025 and explains each model’s strengths, trade‑offs, and ideal use cases. The models are: ChatGPT (the GPT family), Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mixtral, Llama 3, and Grok. The article notes that "Choosing among AI options feels like drinking from a firehose," and that "every vendor promises 'best'", which can lead to analysis paralysis. 

ChatGPT is highlighted for its strong conversational ability and a rich plugin ecosystem, making it suitable for customer chatbots and code assistance.  The trade‑offs include vendor lock‑in, ongoing API costs, and less direct control over model internals unless the team hosts alternatives.

Claude prioritises safety and instruction‑tuning, making it a good fit for sensitive summarisation and policy‑aware assistants.  It can be more expensive per token and often requires careful prompt design for domain specificity.

Gemini focuses on multimodality—text, image, audio—and long context, ideal for products that combine web knowledge with images.  Its tight integration with Google services can be a plus or a con depending on a team’s cloud strategy and data‑governance needs.

DeepSeek is an efficient, open‑weight model that lowers inference cost, suitable for constrained infrastructure or heavy fine‑tuning, though it may lack a mature ecosystem.

Mixtral (a Mistral family MoE model) offers high throughput for specialised workloads and is friendly to deployment, but MoE models can be complex to serve efficiently.

Llama 3 is open‑weight and community‑driven, giving full control for on‑prem deployments, but hosting responsibility falls on the team.

Grok is designed for real‑time social‑feed integration, delivering a persona‑driven conversational experience, yet it depends on live‑feed data and brand‑voice constraints.

The guide recommends benchmarking latency and memory on representative prompts before committing, and illustrates a fintech case study where a hybrid Claude‑Llama 3 pipeline achieved compliance and cost savings.  The article concludes that the "best model" is the one that matches a project’s constraints, team skillset, and regulatory needs, and suggests a two‑week pilot with one managed and one open model.

Key metrics and facts from the article: seven models are listed; the guide was published in 2025; a two‑week pilot is recommended; a fintech startup used Claude for API‑based redaction and Llama 3 for on‑prem NER fine‑tuning.

Quotes used: "drinking from a firehose", "best", "turn‑key", "real‑time", "safe", "efficient", "open‑weight".

title: 第31届IMC上海国际模特大赛全国总决赛颁奖盛典：AI纪元，智启未来时尚
content: The 31st IMC Shanghai International Model Contest National Final Awards Ceremony was held on October 9, 2025, marking a landmark event where technology and fashion converged in a futuristic celebration. The event showcased an AI-driven dynamic visual system that transformed static fashion imagery into immersive, algorithm-generated motion visuals, redefining the boundaries of creative expression. Virtual supermodel MONA, who previously appeared at the 2022 IMC finals, returned as a host, blurring the line between virtual and real, and symbolizing the contest’s forward-thinking vision. The ceremony featured a globally diverse judging panel, including international scouts from IMG, Women, and Silent, as well as renowned Chinese figures such as supermodel Pei Bei, Maggie Mao of GRAZIA, and photographer KK Fong. The final results crowned winners across categories including Annual Champion, International Runway Champion, and National Advertising Champion, with standout finalists like Xuxiang Xiang (3), Macheng Hao (52), Li Wenyu (15), and others. The event emphasized innovation, inclusivity, and the fusion of digital and physical realms, positioning AI not merely as a tool but as a creative collaborator. The contest, organized by Shanghai Fashion Week and managed by Taie Culture and Huoshi Culture, has since 1995 launched the careers of top Chinese models such as Ma Yanli, Liu Hao, and Yu Hang, and continues to expand its reach across regions including Shandong, Shaanxi, and Tibet. Partnerships with over 100 institutions and brands like LIN MAKEUP, ANNAKIKI, and the Shanghai Theatre Academy’s Youth Talent Program underscore its role in shaping the future of fashion. The event concluded with a vision of limitless potential, setting a new standard for the global fashion industry in the AI era.

title: AI版华尔街之狼！o3-mini靠「神之押注」狂赚9倍，DeepSeek R1最特立独行
content: Prophet Arena is a platform that evaluates AI systems' predictive abilities through real-time updates of real-world prediction tasks. The platform uses real-time market event prediction as a basis and has established a dynamic benchmark that cannot be 'cheated'. It comprehensively measures AI's performance in uncertain reasoning, information integration, probability prediction, and real returns. Noam Brown, the head of OpenAI's reasoning research, praised the predictive ability, which is a unique human ability, and AI has finally entered this field. In Prophet Arena, AI models are asked to answer a simple yet fundamental question: Can AI predict real-world events that have not yet occurred? The platform selects popular, diverse, and cyclical real events from platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket as exam questions. AI models use search engines to collect news reports about an event and compile them into a concise 'intelligence report'. They also include the current market price (which can be seen as the collective wisdom of the crowd). 1. Collect information AI models collect the same information and submit a detailed 'prediction report': provide a probability distribution for all possible results and explain why they think so. 3. Results revealed and scoring After the event ends, the results are revealed, and a professional indicator is used to evaluate the accuracy of AI's predictions and update the real-time leaderboard. The leaderboard mainly looks at two indicators: the Brier score (higher is better) and the average return of simulated real bets (who can make money). In addition to the two core indicators, Prophet Arena also uses advanced evaluation methods inspired by statistics and psychological measurement modeling, such as Item Response Theory (IRT) and Generalized Bradley-Terry (BT) models. These supplementary indicators enrich the leaderboard, allowing for a more detailed and comprehensive understanding of predictive intelligence.

title: 闪电快讯｜荣耀Magic8系列正式发布，影像性能AI全面自进化
content: On October 15, 2025, Honor officially launched its annual flagship series, the Honor Magic8, alongside the new MagicOS 10 operating system. The Magic8 series features three core innovations: the self-evolving AI agent YOYO, a 200-megapixel ultra-night telephoto camera, and a new 7000mAh青海湖 (Qinghai Lake) battery. The standard version starts at 4499 yuan, while the Pro version starts at 5699 yuan, with both models available for purchase starting October 23, 2025. MagicOS 10 integrates Honor’s proprietary AI agent YOYO, which has self-learning and self-evolving capabilities, enabling it to autonomously perform tasks across 3,000+ scenarios such as 'clothing, food, housing, transportation, and shopping.' Powered by the Honor Magic Large Model 3.0, YOYO achieves SOTA-level performance in multimodal understanding, task planning, and tool utilization, earning it a China Academy of Information and Communications Technology (CAICT) L3-level Excellence certification—the highest recognition for generalization capability in AI agents. YOYO’s two core capabilities are 'YOYO See' (AI-powered visual intelligence) and 'YOYO Execute' (industry-leading AI execution engine). All models include a dedicated AI button; long-pressing it activates YOYO See and enables video calls and intelligent agent interaction. The camera system is a major highlight: the Magic8 Pro’s main sensor features a 200MP ultra-night telephoto lens with a large sensor, large aperture, and fluorite-grade optics. The new AiMAGE imaging system includes three core engines: AiMAGE·Night God Engine (80 million inferences per second for precise handling of complex lighting), AiMAGE·Anti-Shake Engine (achieving CIPA 5.5-level stabilization), and AiMAGE·Portrait Engine (12 billion parameters, enhancing skin texture, lighting accuracy, and bokeh realism). AI photography features include Inspiration Shooting, AI Color Tracking, AI Photo Editing, Free-Style Image Generation, and new Live Photo functionality, enabling a full-cycle creative experience from pre-shoot guidance to post-shoot optimization. All models are powered by the fifth-generation Snapdragon® 8 Ultimate mobile platform, with significant improvements in CPU, GPU, and AI performance. Honor and Qualcomm jointly optimized the underlying architecture, ensuring stable frame rates and efficient power control under high load. Honor’s proprietary AI rendering separation technology and chip-level tuning deliver 0-jitter gameplay, allowing smooth 1080P maximum graphics gaming without lag or frame drops. Battery life is enhanced by the 7000mAh Qinghai Lake battery, supporting 120W wired fast charging and 80W wireless charging. With Honor’s Dujiangyan AI Power Management System and Snapdragon chip-level tuning, typical scenario power consumption is reduced by 13%, with the Magic8 Pro achieving the top spot in flagship phone battery life. Design-wise, the standard model features a small flat screen with a slim, lightweight feel, while the Pro model has a slightly curved screen with color options including Sunrise Gold Sand, Snow White, and Velvet Black. The devices earned SGS Five-Star certification for drop and scratch resistance and achieved full IP68, IP69, and IP69K dust and water resistance ratings. Beyond smartphones, Honor also launched ecosystem products: the MagicPad3 series tablets (featuring the fifth-gen Snapdragon® 8 Ultimate), the Honor Watch 5 Pro with 24/7 blood pressure monitoring, and the Earbuds 4 with 46 hours of battery life. Honor also announced a new AI device form factor — the ROBOT PHONE — integrating AI agents with robotics, scheduled to debut in Barcelona in 2026.

title: Orla Dempsey: Guess missed the point with its AI model - it's their imperfections that made the supermodels legendary
content: Guess’s AI‑generated model, featured in Vogue’s August issue, has sparked debate. The ad shows a flawless, AI‑created blonde with no pores, which critics say sets an unattainable standard. The article notes that the model’s perfection is ‘deplorable’ and that it ‘states – albeit discreetly – on the advert that she’s AI generated.’ Industry insiders feel disheartened, while some applaud the transparency. The piece contrasts AI perfection with real models such as Twiggy, Kate Moss and Winnie Harlow, who are celebrated for their unique imperfections. The author argues that AI models lack the ‘twinkle in their eye’ and originality that human models bring, and warns that AI could threaten real modeling jobs.

title: AI Headshot Generators
content: AIEasyShot is an AI‑driven platform that converts user selfies into professional‑quality headshots, generating over 60 variations with different backgrounds, styles, and compositions. By automating the headshot creation process, it reduces time, cost, and logistical constraints. For professionals, freelancers, and businesses, the tool offers consistent, high‑quality visual representation across websites, portfolios, social media profiles, and corporate materials. The AI system ensures realistic facial features and appropriate lighting, enhancing visual credibility. AIEasyShot reflects a broader trend of AI applications in professional branding and digital presence management, streamlining workflows while providing scalable, personalized visual assets for career and business use.

title: ChatGPT faces rising competition as Gemini and Grok gain ground, says new AI report - BusinessToday
content: A16z’s latest consumer‑AI report shows that while ChatGPT remains the global leader, Google’s Gemini and Elon Musk’s xAI chatbot Grok are rapidly narrowing the gap. The report tracks 14 AI products that consistently rank among the most used, including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Character AI, Midjourney, ElevenLabs and Hugging Face. Google’s Gemini, AI Studio, NotebookLM and Google Labs now occupy four spots on the list, with Gemini the No. 2 AI app on both mobile and web. Gemini has almost half as many monthly active users as ChatGPT, yet on Android it commands nearly 90 % of its active user base. Grok ranks fourth on the web and 23rd on mobile, boasting more than 20 million monthly active users and a 40 % surge after the release of Grok 4 in July. Meta AI sits at No. 46 on the web and failed to break into the top mobile rankings after privacy‑related backlash. Chinese developers dominate the mobile landscape: 22 of the top 50 mobile AI apps originate in China, with ByteDance’s Doubao at No. 4 on mobile, and Moonshot AI’s Kimi and Alibaba’s Quark in the web top 20. The report also highlights emerging startups such as Replit and Lovable, noting that app‑store crackdowns on ChatGPT clones have allowed original products to grow. Despite mounting competition, ChatGPT continues to lead globally, but the rapid rise of Gemini and Grok signals a market that is becoming increasingly fragmented, with multiple players vying for user attention. The report notes, 'These products now have their own separate domains, allowing their growth to be tracked independently.'

title: 2亿超夜神 AI自进化，荣耀Magic8系列正式发布，售价4499元起
content: On October 15, 2025, Honor officially launched its highly anticipated flagship series, the Honor Magic8, alongside the new self-evolving AI intelligent agent operating system, MagicOS 10. The Magic8 series is positioned as the first 'self-evolving AI-native smartphone' with '8 AI technology leadership, 8 AI experience leadership, 4 imaging leadership, and 8 performance leadership.' The launch theme 'Opening a New Chapter, Seeing the Future' marks Honor's systemic declaration in the AI era, emphasizing a future of self-evolving AI-native phones, new product forms, and lifestyle innovation. The MagicOS 10 system features the AI agent YOYO, which acts as a 'companion' across 3,000+ scenarios including 'clothing, food, housing, travel, and shopping.' Powered by Honor's Magic Large Model 3.0 and the industry's first system-level MCP architecture, YOYO achieves China's authoritative L3-level excellence certification. It features 'YOYO See' (industry-leading AI visual perception) and 'YOYO Execute' (industry-leading AI execution engine), supported by a dedicated AI button for instant activation. The system enables automated execution across 3,000+ scenarios through integration with over 4,000 ecosystem MCPs and agents. 'Honor Share' has evolved into 'Honor Borderless Intelligence Link,' enabling cross-platform, cross-ecosystem connectivity across brands including HarmonyOS and iOS. Honor also introduced the 'MagicOS Monthly Refresh Plan,' offering monthly OTA updates to allow users to actively participate in the phone’s evolution. The Magic8 Pro features a 200MP 'Super Night God' telephoto lens with a large sensor, high aperture, advanced materials like fluorite-grade glass and aerospace-grade packaging, and a self-evolving AiMAGE imaging system. AiMAGE includes the Night God Engine (80 million inferences/sec), Anti-Shake Engine (CIPA 5.5-level stabilization), and Portrait Engine (12 billion parameters), enabling professional-grade imaging. AI-powered features like AI color tracking, AI photo editing, free-form image generation, and Live Photo modes offer full-cycle photography support. Performance-wise, the Magic8 series features the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 flagship chip, AI-optimized by Honor and Qualcomm, delivering cross-generation performance. The Magic8 series also features the new Qinghai Lake battery with over 7,000mAh capacity, supporting 120W wired and 80W wireless fast charging, and achieving industry-leading battery life. The phones include a 'Golden Green Oasis' eye-protective screen with 6,000 nits peak brightness and the world’s first TÜV Rheinland Global Eye Protection 5.0 certification. Communication is enhanced via Honor’s proprietary 'Five Chips, Six Wings' architecture, AI self-adaptive signal tuning, and support for 23 global 5G bands and Google’s full suite of services. Security features include dual 3D biometric unlocking, EU payment-grade certification, dual TEE security engines, parallel space protection, and a three-tier AI anti-fraud system that detects deepfakes, voice changes, and scam scripts—recognized by Time Magazine as one of the 'Best Inventions of 2025.' The devices feature Honor’s Giant Rhino Glass, 10x drop resistance, and IP68/IP69/IP69K full dust and water resistance. Audio features include a self-developed open acoustic chamber, dual 1216 speakers, and AI acoustic algorithms for premium surround sound. Design includes the 'Most Beautiful Small Straight Screen' for the standard model and the 'Elegant Micro-Curved Screen' for the Pro model. The Magic8 series integrates advanced technologies from Goodix, including ultrasonic fingerprint sensors (faster, water/oil-resistant), intelligent audio amplifiers (efficient, low-noise), and touch control chips (smooth touch). Honor also unveiled the Honor Watch 5 Pro with 24/7 blood pressure monitoring, and other ecosystem products including the MagicPad3 Pro (world’s first Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 tablet), MagicPad3 12.5 (with new 'Fang Qing Song' and 'Good Luck Purple' colors), and Earbuds 4 (46+ hours battery). The Honor Magic8 series is available starting October 23, 2025, with the standard version priced at 4,499 yuan and the Pro version at 5,699 yuan. Honor also announced the upcoming Honor ROBOT PHONE, set to debut in Barcelona in 2026, with features including an AI 'super brain,' robotic mobility, and AI-powered photography. The product will be available for hands-on experience at Honor Alpha Global Flagship Stores.

title: Quem é a sua modelo favorita? As pessoas que vai ver neste artigo são lindas mas não existem
content: The August 2025 issue of American Vogue, featuring Anne Hathaway on the cover, also carried ads from the Californian apparel brand Guess that used artificial‑intelligence (AI) generated models. The campaign was produced by Seraphinne Vallora, a London‑based marketing agency that employs AI and has previously been highlighted in Elle, The Wall Street Journal and Harper’s Bazaar. A TikTok user, @lala4an, posted a video about the Guess ad that has accumulated more than 2.7 million views. In the comments, one user wrote, ‘É uma loucura. Não é como se faltassem pessoas à procura de trabalhos como modelo ou algo assim’ and the post has received 67 700 likes; another user added, ‘Então, primeiro as mulheres normais estão a comparar‑se com modelos reais mas editadas em photoshop… Agora temos que nos comparar com mulheres que nem sequer existem???’ The controversy prompted calls for a boycott of Guess and Vogue. Guess declined to comment, while a Condé Nast spokesperson confirmed that no AI model had appeared editorially in Vogue, though Vogue Singapore had shown AI avatars in its March 2023 issue. Seraphinne Vallora’s co‑founders, Valentina Gonzalez and Andreea Petrescu, explained that the AI models were created after a real model was photographed in a studio to inform poses; they also hire real models. They were approached by Guess founder Paul Marciano, who selected a digital blonde (Vivienne) and brunette (Anastasia); Vivienne later went viral. Other brands have followed suit: Mango launched its first AI‑generated campaign in July 2024, and Levi’s announced in March 2023 that it would test AI models to diversify body types and skin tones. Critics argue that AI models give a façade of diversity without real investment and may displace professional models, photographers, and makeup artists. Mango CEO Toni Ruiz defended the use of AI by saying, ‘Trata‑se de uma criação de conteúdo mais rápida.’ Levi’s clarified that it would not reduce live photo sessions. Seraphinne Vallora’s AI models are predominantly white and conform to conventional beauty standards; Petrescu noted that they followed client guidance rather than technical limitations. Model Alliance founder Sara Ziff warned that the rise of AI models must be managed responsibly, asking who is paid, who is seen, and who is erased. The article also references virtual influencers such as Lil Miquela and Shudu, H&M’s plan to create AI twins of 30 real models (each retaining rights to their twin), Dior’s 2021 digital version of Angelababy, and Burberry’s digital Naomi Campbell. Spring Studios director Lara Ferris described how digital models allow rapid, large‑scale image creation, while Michael Musandu, CEO of Lalaland.ai, said AI models complement rather than replace real models. Finally, the New York Fashion Workers Law, enacted in June 2024, aims to protect models and is highlighted by Ziff as a starting point for safeguarding workers in the industry.

title: (Day19)虛擬主播/AI分身：社群互動與數位形象經營 - iT 邦幫忙::一起幫忙解決難題，拯救 IT 人的一天
content: Generative AI technology is transforming the landscape of virtual anchors and AI avatars in social media engagement and digital identity management. Platforms such as Synthesia, Vidnoz AI, D-ID, Elai, and Edimakor use deep learning for facial animation, text-to-speech (TTS), and multilingual support to create AI-driven digital avatars that mimic human speech patterns and facial expressions. These avatars can operate 24/7, respond instantly to audience interactions, and generate content without requiring a filming crew—simply by uploading an image and inputting text or voice. Advanced large language models enable real-time understanding of social media comments, allowing AI anchors to generate personalized responses and foster deeper audience engagement. This capability supports continuous operation in marketing, live product sales, and training. Brands and creators can build unique digital personas with defined names, appearances, voices, and emotional expressions, then use AI to automatically generate scripts, tweets, and short videos. Integrated with AI image generation tools like Midjourney and OpenArt, and video editing software, digital identities can be updated dynamically to stay fresh and responsive to events, holidays, or fan interactions. The trend points toward a future of 'AI avatar companionship' in social media, enabling scalable, flexible, and rapid content creation that redefines digital content ecosystems and opens new possibilities for identity, interaction, and monetization.
